request.prompt:
Create a strong HAVENLINE World 1 authored upgrade proposal, matching supplied selected references in stylized rounded 3D craft, warm orange timber, deep blue steel, rounded gray hardware and soft sculpted snow. Meaningful new functional structures, no recolor/brackets-only upgrade. Clean navy studio background and large readable objects. Exactly TWO rows by THREE roomy columns. Each row is one coherent new stage shown in front/exterior three-quarter, true opposite rear/interior three-quarter, and a functional cutaway/detail of that same design. No level numbers, prices, stat multipliers or implementation claims. Short stage/view labels and footer AUTHORED UPGRADE PROPOSAL. HEADER HAVENLINE / WALL AND GUARD TOWER. TOP ROW label GUARDWALK DEFENSE. Create one short coherent wall-and-tower module: thick timber palisade, low masonry footing, outward spike skirt, a broad protected interior guardwalk, a clearly usable staircase on the CAMP side, and a raised braced timber firing deck. On the firing deck place one unmistakable hand-loaded mechanical ballista, with transverse bow arms, a straight bolt guide, manual cocking crank, an operator standing space behind it and a small inner bolt rack. Weapon points away from camp. BOTTOM ROW label BOLT BASTION. Create the substantial later version: heavier masonry-and-blue tower and buttresses, a wider protected guardwalk, a roofed inner ammunition platform, a small hand-operated ammo hoist, and a more capable manually operated repeating ballista with a clearly visible finite bolt cassette, cocking mechanism and clear operator/reload positions. Same material family, but an obvious larger structural and functional upgrade. Show correct-sized wooden-shaft metal-head bolts only in actual racks/cassette. No people are required; unobstructed human-sized access spaces must be credible. For each row show EXTERIOR: the outward spike/weapon side, INTERIOR: the true opposite side exposing the camp-side stair, safe walk and reload access, FUNCTION: a close cutaway/angled view of the same firing deck and supply path. The third view must not grow extra weapons or swap the stair side. Keep firing sweep entirely outward and physically clear of walls; spikes do not point into the camp. This is a modular wall section, not an enclosing full camp: do not add a gate, third pedestrian opening, decorative door in a solid wall, electric glow or powered laser. Preserve the game rule that the two existing pedestrian gates and their approaches remain untouched at placement. The source watchtower sheet supplies material vocabulary only; this is a new authored functional tower, not a reconstruction of an unavailable original.
Spatial clarity is essential: the camp-side stairs must meet an open landing in the rear parapet without a rail or timber wall sealing the last step; maintain this same stair entry across all three views. In the close-up show the exact same ballista and a visible handle-driven cocking winch; the bolt guide is open above the wall, with bow tips clear. The repeating cassette must contain recognizably separate wooden bolts with metal heads. Any ammunition hoist is a hand-cranked rope pulley with a real handle and load cradle. Don't crop any wall, footings, stairs or weapon extremities.
